certification.name: F5 Certified Technology Specialist, BIG-IP LTM
certification.description: Specialist certification on architecting, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting BIG-IP Local Traffic Manager. Requires exams 301a and 301b, 90 minutes each, on top of the F5 Certified Administrator, BIG-IP.
certification.currency_note: Per exam; two exams required (301a and 301b) after the F5 Certified Administrator, BIG-IP
